title: Towards Efficient Evaluation of Evolutionary Transfer Optimization: Case Studies on Task-Parameterized Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.05040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As evolutionary transfer optimization (ETO) scales to larger collections of related tasks, problem evaluation can become a major source of runtime growth. This work studies problem-side evaluation scaling in task-parameterized applications and reformulates application-specific serial computations into forms suitable for parallel execution. We organize evaluation scaling into two levels: the number of evaluated tasks and the workload within each task. In multi-task optimization, matrix-recursive kinematic-arm evaluation is reformulated using an accumulation-matrix representation of cumulative link directions. In sequential transfer optimization, pointwise B-spline trajectory evaluation is reformulated using a blending-matrix representation for trajectory and collision computations. Both reformulations maintain close numerical agreement with their reference evaluations and substantially reduce runtime, yielding $256.72\times$ and $93.91\ti

translated_title: 迈向演化迁移优化的高效评估：基于任务参数化应用的案例研究
translated_abstract: 随着演化迁移优化（ETO）扩展到更大规模的相关任务集合，问题评估可能成为运行时间增长的主要来源。本研究针对任务参数化应用中的问题侧评估扩展性展开研究，并将特定应用的串行计算重构为适合并行执行的形式。我们将评估扩展性归纳为两个层面：被评估任务的数量以及每个任务内部的工作负载。在多任务优化中，基于矩阵递归的机械臂评估被重构为采用累积矩阵表示累积连杆方向的形式。在顺序迁移优化中，逐点B样条轨迹评估被重构为采用混合矩阵表示以进行轨迹与碰撞计算。两种重构方法均与参考评估保持高度的数值一致性，并显著降低运行时间，分别取得了256.72倍和93.91倍的加速。
tldr: 该论文将任务参数化应用中的串行评估计算重构为基于累积矩阵和混合矩阵的并行化形式，在多任务优化和顺序迁移优化中分别实现约256.72倍和93.91倍的运行时间加速，同时保持数值精度。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates serial evaluation computations in task-parameterized applications into parallel-friendly matrix representations (accumulation-matrix and blending-matrix), achieving up to 256.72× and 93.91× runtime speedups in multi-task and sequential transfer optimization while maintaining numerical accuracy.
